slides.body: A Raja Yoga (royal combination) forms when the lord of a kendra (angular house: 1, 4, 7, 10) connects with the lord of a trikona (trine house: 1, 5, 9). Connection means conjunction, mutual aspect or exchange.
Many charts hold some version of this. Famous charts show it at full strength. Yours may be smaller, partial or well hidden.

points: Are both planets strong in sign and house?
Are they free of heavy affliction?
Does the Navamsa (D-9, inner-strength chart) support them?
Does a dasha of these planets ever run?

slides.body: A yoga shows potential, not a promise. Strength, timing and effort decide what shows up. Be wary of anyone who says a yoga guarantees success.
